text.tspan: Global aquaculture production and wild fish used for animal feed
Some wild fish catch is processed into fishmeal and oils for animal feed – this is used for land-based livestock
Efficiency improvements in aquaculture, and changes in the diets of farmed fish means production has increased
rapidly, without increasing inputs from wild fish.
Wild fish used as fishmeal and oil

tspan.tspan: Sea Around Us (2020); Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), via World Bank (2026)
